messages:
alinor (BD): Quick sync — HW partner (NimbleAccel) pushed back on our standard marketplace SKU. They want a bundled Reserved Capacity SKU + SI integration discount available as a private marketplace listing. cc @maria-pm @leo-partner-eng

maria-pm: Thanks for flagging. High-level goals: 1) keep unit economics predictable, 2) avoid open-ended discounting, 3) have a clean renewal path (yearly with delta adjustments).

jaya-sales: From deals side: buyer expects 12-18 month commit, 20-25% off list for the first year, with a 10% renewal floor. They also want usage-based true-ups. Is that workable?

leo-partner-eng: Technical constraint: Reserved Capacity SKU only applies to hosted or dedicated. If the SI bundles on-prem deploy, we need an explicit on-prem addon SKU (different PO flow). Also: the SI wants a technical integration credit of $X that counts against commit — is that discount allowed to be applied as part of committed spend?

steve-legal: Two quick items: 1) Need to cap the discount stack (e.g., marketplace promo + partner rebate + sales concession) to avoid revenue leakage. 2) Add a clause for price protection on renewals (we can set a +/-5% cap) and a clear termination/true-up window (30 days post-period). Can we draft a templated clause?

finance-ops-bot: Posting suggested pricing model (rough):

```
Reserved SKU: rwd-resv-4gpu -> list $120k/mo
Partner bundle discount: 22% (applies to first 12 months)
SI integration credit: treat as a one-time rebate (cap at 10% of commit)
Renewal floor: 10% off list; price protection +/-5%
True-up: monthly usage reporting; settle within 30 days
```

maria-pm: Suggested approach to keep this manageable: create two marketplace SKUs: 1) reserved-hosted-bundle (applies only to hosted/dedicated) and 2) si-onprem-addon (for on-prem deployments, invoice separately). Then implement gating rules in the private-offer: allowed_discount_types = ["bundle", "rebate"], max_effective_discount = 30%.

alinor (BD): That sounds reasonable. Sales ask: can we set a minimum commit of $250k ARR to qualify for the combined discount?

jaya-sales: Yes, minimum commit is OK. Also request inclusion of an early-adopter credit for first 3 customers (one-time $25k) — limited stock.

steve-legal: Early-adopter credits must be documented as non-recurring credits that do not alter the contractual list price. We'll add language.

leo-partner-eng: Ops question: will the marketplace support reporting that attributes consumption to the reserved SKU vs the SI-managed units? We need that for telemetry and partner revenue share. If not, we should require tagging in the deployment manifest.

finance-ops-bot: Telemetry: recommend we require `partner_tag` and `si_id` metadata for each allocation. We can add to billing pipeline filter. Impacts: 1 FTE for ~2 weeks to wire through.

maria-pm: Tactical next steps:
- Product: define SKU family and gating rules (by Fri 04/09)
- Legal: draft private offer template & early-adopter credit clause (Mon 04/12)
- Ops/Eng: confirm telemetry tagging and estimate work (Tue 04/13)
- Sales/BD: finalize minimum commit and first-customer list (Thu 04/15)

alinor (BD): Perfect. I'll align with NimbleAccel on those dates and push for a joint announcement only after the first successful deployment. Also, if partners want co-marketing, require co-announcement review 2 weeks prior.

jaya-sales: Agree. I'll loop in the channel partner manager and book a joint kickoff. :thumbsup:

steve-legal: I'll start a draft and share in this thread when ready.

leo-partner-eng: Will scope the tagging work and post an ETA here by EOD tomorrow.

finance-ops-bot: Noted — cost impact estimate queued.

alinor (BD): Thanks all. If anyone sees blocker items, flag here. Otherwise we'll treat this as our canonical plan for the NimbleAccel marketplace bundle.
